Release notes/v0.9.0/Nov 14, 2026

What's new in Cadence 0.9.0.

Continuous Talk: keep talking, and Cadence sends each request when you've finished it.

By Cadence Labs · Filed in Releases

§01 New

  • Continuous Talk. Triple-tap your Talk key. (Double-tap still opens ordinary Talk, and hold still dictates.) The microphone stays on, and Cadence listens for the moment a request is complete.
    • A finished request gets a five-second preview with Keep talking and Send now. Start speaking again and the send is cancelled, so an afterthought ("…but not on main") stays part of the same request.
    • Keep talking pauses auto-send until you choose Send request or Resume auto-send.
    • Requests go through the normal Talk router (agents, projects, skills, screenshots, the Director), and you can keep talking while an earlier request is still being routed.
    • A workspace built for each task shows what your agents are doing as it happens: explanations, comparisons, code walkthroughs and previews, with the agent table and transcript always one click away.
    • Press Escape, press the hotkey, or stop the mic to leave. Work already sent to agents keeps running.
  • Codex takes over when Claude is out. When your Claude plan hits a usage limit or is unavailable, Cadence's own models (Talk routing, Continuous Talk and the Director) switch to your signed-in Codex CLI, then return to Claude once it's back. Agents already running keep their own runtime.
    • The Director hands its request to Codex on the same conversation. A turn that had already started changing something is never replayed automatically.
    • Cadence never buys credits or uses API keys. It only uses the accounts you're already signed in to.
